name: Sudan
value: WFP drops 900,000 people; Blue Nile drone deaths
summary: WFP says funding cuts removed 900,000 people from food aid; an RSF drone killed 9 in Blue Nile, reported 10 Nov
state: WFP said on 12 Nov that funding shortfalls cut the number it reaches in Sudan from over 4 million in August to just over 3 million, with about 900,000 people losing food aid; in August it was helping 880,000 people in famine-risk areas (UN News). A local governor said an RSF drone strike on Bani Shako village in Blue Nile state killed at least nine civilians, reported on 10 Nov (Anadolu via A News). Repeated deadly drone strikes on civilians and hunger in famine-risk areas keep the Alert.
for_you: Civilians in Darfur, Kordofan and Blue Nile face drone strikes, displacement and hunger. Travellers should follow FCDO advice against all travel to Sudan. Neighbouring Chad, South Sudan and Egypt continue to receive refugees.
rubric_hit: Alert: repeated deadly drone strikes on civilians and famine risk in Darfur and Kordofan (WFP cut 900,000 from aid, 12 Nov)
